entries.1a49e63f01ad9354: Niitaka operates a chemical business that manufactures and sells commercial detergents, cleaning agents and solid fuel, and a healthcare business that handles health foods.
entries.65ed4f54c8cc047b: This business manufactures and sells health foods such as the plant-fermented extract supplement 'ＯＭ-Ｘ'. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥1,351 million. Its consolidated subsidiary, Biobank Co., Ltd., is responsible for manufacturing and sales.
entries.6adf3e8a0233a009: The company provides regular and emergency maintenance of dishwashers, hygiene training, bacteria testing, hygiene patrol services and similar services. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.b3ee973357340de1: A business that manufactures and sells commercial detergents, cleaning agents, disinfectants, bleaches, alcohol preparations, commercial solid fuel, and purchased merchandise, among others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥23,267 million. The main production bases are the Biwako Plant and Tsukuba Plant, and it also provides dishwasher maintenance and hygiene services.
entries.e1dc8815d0785038: Commercial detergents and cleaning agents, etc.
entries.ff5e36da60ee2d83: It manufactures and sells dishwashing detergents, detergents for dishwashers, bleaches, alcohol preparations, hand-washing soaps, and other products. Revenue by product category is not disclosed.
entries.ffcb054f47ef19d2: The company manufactures and sells commercial-use solid fuels such as 'Kaen New Ace Ｅ' and 'Kaen High Super'. Revenue by product category is not disclosed.
